work_history.title: Freelance UI/UX and AI Video Creator
work_history.description: Helps tech startups shape their branding and bring MVPs to life with clear, user-focused design. Produces high-converting video ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube using AI-powered video editing. AI video editing engagements include a corporate AI knowledge-assistant startup and a facility-management SaaS company.

work_history.title: Senior Product Designer
work_history.description: Collaborated with cross-functional teams to create products meeting business goals and client needs. Worked closely with international client teams (flavours & fragrances, security technology, energy and healthcare) to ensure technical feasibility of designs. Fully remote.

work_history.title: UX Consultant
work_history.description: Part of the regional campaign UX design team, improving user experience for large-scale regional campaigns. Contributed to research & consulting: user insights, usability studies and recommendations to optimize the customer journey.

work_history.title: Senior Product Designer
work_history.description: Ran multiple design and product iterations to find product-market fit: gathered user feedback, refined the UX and improved the product based on real-world insights. Collaborated closely with developers to integrate design changes, balancing user needs and technical feasibility.

work_history.title: Senior UX Designer
work_history.description: Led UX research and managed and mentored a multidisciplinary team of UX and UI designers. Oversaw the end-to-end design process with a strong user-centered focus. Tools: Sketch, Overflow, Zeplin, Maze, InVision, Miro, Principle, Lookback, Jira.

work_history.title: Senior UX Designer
work_history.description: Crafted user journeys and user stories; built low, mid and high-fidelity wireframes; led information architecture and UX flows. Collaborated remotely with the PM and React Native developers on healthcare-tech and education products. Tools: Sketch, Adobe XD, Marvel, Zoom.

work_history.title: Product Designer
work_history.description: Led the UX/UI revamp of the merchant dashboard, main website and tracking system; contributed to the partner web app UX. Worked remotely with the CTO, CPO and web developers on e-commerce logistics products. Tools: Sketch, Marvel, Zeplin, Slack, Jira.

work_history.title: Associate Project Director
work_history.description: Handled digital projects, ensuring on-time, in-scope, on-budget delivery. Managed third-party vendors. Focus on website, mobile app and digital banner ad development (dynamic and static HTML5/GIF), including Dynamic Creative Optimization campaigns. Tools: Google DoubleClick, Google Web Designer.

education: Bachelor's Degree, Human Computer Interaction — Bogor Agricultural University (2013)；Associate's Degree — Bogor Agricultural University (2008)
latest_degree: Human Computer Interaction — Bogor Agricultural University
